# ================================================================ # Stage 3-1: GOGS API Client (실시간 저장소 데이터 연동) # https://gogs.dclub.kr API를 통해 실제 저장소 데이터 조회 # ================================================================ # ================================================================ # Part 1: HTTP 요청 빌더 # ================================================================ # GOGS API 기본 설정 fn getGogsBaseUrl(): string { return "https://gogs.dclub.kr/api/v1" } fn getGogsOwner(): string { return "kim" } # API 요청 구성 (헤더 포함) fn buildApiRequest(method: string, endpoint: string, token: string): map { return { "method": method, "url": getGogsBaseUrl() + endpoint, "headers": { "Authorization": "token " + token, "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json" }, "timeout": 10000 } } # GET 요청 빌더 fn buildGetRequest(endpoint: string, token: string): map { return buildApiRequest("GET", endpoint, token) } # POST 요청 빌더 (바디 포함) fn buildPostRequest(endpoint: string, token: string, body: string): map { let req = buildApiRequest("POST", endpoint, token) req["body"] = body return req } # ================================================================ # Part 2: GOGS 저장소 API # ================================================================ # 사용자 저장소 목록 조회 엔드포인트 fn getReposEndpoint(owner: string): string { return "/repos/search?q=&uid=0&limit=50&page=1" } # 특정 저장소 정보 엔드포인트 fn getRepoEndpoint(owner: string, repoName: string): string { return "/repos/" + owner + "/" + repoName } # 저장소 커밋 목록 엔드포인트 fn getCommitsEndpoint(owner: string, repoName: string, branch: string): string { return "/repos/" + owner + "/" + repoName + "/commits?sha=" + branch + "&limit=10" } # 저장소 브랜치 목록 엔드포인트 fn getBranchesEndpoint(owner: string, repoName: string): string { return "/repos/" + owner + "/" + repoName + "/branches" } # 저장소 이슈 목록 엔드포인트 fn getIssuesEndpoint(owner: string, repoName: string): string { return "/repos/" + owner + "/" + repoName + "/issues?type=issues&state=open&limit=10" } # 저장소 릴리스 목록 엔드포인트 fn getReleasesEndpoint(owner: string, repoName: string): string { return "/repos/" + owner + "/" + repoName + "/releases?limit=5" } # ================================================================ # Part 3: API 응답 파서 (JSON → map) # ================================================================ # 저장소 기본 정보 파싱 fn parseRepoInfo(repoName: string, stars: i32, forks: i32, openIssues: i32, language: string, updatedAt: string, defaultBranch: string): map { return { "name": repoName, "fullName": getGogsOwner() + "/" + repoName, "stars": stars, "forks": forks, "openIssues": openIssues, "language": language, "updatedAt": updatedAt, "defaultBranch": defaultBranch, "apiUrl": getGogsBaseUrl() + getRepoEndpoint(getGogsOwner(), repoName), "webUrl": "https://gogs.dclub.kr/" + getGogsOwner() + "/" + repoName, "activityScore": calculateRepoActivity(stars, forks, openIssues) } } # 저장소 활동 점수 계산 (Cataloger의 scoring과 동일 로직) fn calculateRepoActivity(stars: i32, forks: i32, openIssues: i32): i32 { return (stars * 40) + (forks * 30) + (openIssues * 30) } # 커밋 정보 파싱 fn parseCommitInfo(sha: string, message: string, authorName: string, authorDate: string): map { let shortSha = substr(sha, 0, 8) return { "sha": sha, "shortSha": shortSha, "message": message, "shortMessage": if len(message) > 72 then substr(message, 0, 72) + "..." else message, "authorName": authorName, "authorDate": authorDate, "commitType": detectCommitType(message) } } # 커밋 타입 감지 (conventional commits) fn detectCommitType(message: string): string { if startsWith(message, "feat") { return "feature" } else if startsWith(message, "fix") { return "bugfix" } else if startsWith(message, "docs") { return "docs" } else if startsWith(message, "test") { return "test" } else if startsWith(message, "refactor") { return "refactor" } else if startsWith(message, "chore") { return "chore" } else { return "other" } } # 이슈 정보 파싱 fn parseIssueInfo(issueNumber: i32, title: string, state: string, labels: string, createdAt: string): map { return { "number": issueNumber, "title": title, "state": state, "labels": labels, "createdAt": createdAt, "priority": detectIssuePriority(labels), "url": "#" + intToStr(issueNumber) } } # 이슈 우선순위 감지 fn detectIssuePriority(labels: string): string { if contains(labels, "critical") || contains(labels, "urgent") { return "critical" } else if contains(labels, "high") || contains(labels, "bug") { return "high" } else if contains(labels, "enhancement") || contains(labels, "feature") { return "medium" } else { return "low" } } #
